rationale: MLX docs suggest reducing unnecessary evaluation overhead. Keep the current best model/export path, but raise VAL_BATCH_SIZE to 16384, cut FINAL_EVAL_ESTIMATE_BATCHES to 1, and rerun with a fresh seed to test whether cheaper exact-endgame budgeting improves the 10-minute result without changing architecture.
title: Seed 2026 + Faster Exact Endgame On Recurrent-Tail Best
